desc: Ideation: establish that the reachable set is a connected region, greedy min-frontier absorption is optimal, and stopping at the first non-absorbable minimum is correct.
Write the complete Python solution (I/O parsing + min-heap frontier greedy + output) in one file.
Edge-case review: X=1 strictness, H=1 or W=1 boundary neighbor computation with flat indices, 1×1 grid, nothing absorbable (answer = S[P][Q]), pure-integer comparison `s * X < cur`.
Performance pass: flat indexing, encoded int heap items (`s*n + idx`), mark seen on push to avoid duplicate heap entries — O(HW log HW).
Validation: samples traced (28, 5), termination/correctness argument verified.
